title: The Shifting Ossuary
objective: Find the ossuary's tomb and lay its guardian to rest. Leave by the gate if it gets too much.

rooms.name: Ossuary Gate
rooms.description: A rusted gate stands open on a stair down into the ossuary.

rooms.name: Bone Hall
rooms.description: Skulls are stacked to the ceiling along every wall. A low door leads to a side crypt, and an arch to the tomb.

features.name: Skull Wall
features.description: A wall of stacked skulls, some of them loose.

failure.text: The skulls stare back at you, and give nothing away.

success.text: A draught stirs the dust between two loose skulls: there is a space behind the wall.

rooms.name: Reliquary
rooms.description: A cramped chamber behind the skull wall, its niches full of dust.

features.name: Reliquary Niche
features.description: A niche cut deeper than the rest.
features.discovery: At the back of the niche lies a bone box bound in silver.

items.name: Bone Box
items.description: A small box of carved bone, bound in silver.

rooms.name: Side Crypt
rooms.description: A crypt with a single shelf of urns.

features.name: Urn Shelf
features.description: A shelf of cracked funeral urns.
features.discovery: One urn holds a stoppered vial of red liquid.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

rooms.name: Tomb
rooms.description: A round tomb where something gnaws at the bones of the dead.

passages.description: The stair down into the ossuary.
A gap behind the loose skulls.

door.name: Rotten Door
door.description: A door of rotten planks, stuck in a sagging frame.

failure.text: The sagging frame gives way, and the ceiling comes down across the doorway.

endings.title: The tomb is quiet
endings.text: The rat lies still among the bones.

endings.title: Out with the box
endings.text: You climb out with the bone box.
